# Vendored third-party code

## lame.min.js  (lamejs 1.2.1 — a JavaScript port of the LAME MP3 encoder)

- Licence: **LGPL-3.0** (`LGPL-3.0.txt`; the project's own note is in `lamejs-LICENSE.txt`). LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
- Shipped **unmodified, as its own file**, so you can replace it with another build. LOOM's own scripts do not include it: the studio downloads
  it only when you press *export ▸ MP3*.
- Source: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs (npm `lamejs@1.2.1`). If you ship LOOM, keep this folder with it and acknowledge LAME.
